name: Ruins of Alph Chambers & Sliding Tile Puzzles
summary: Travel into the enigmatic Ruins of Alph. Access Chambers A, B, and C directly from Routes 36 and 32, then descend into Union Cave B1F to locate hidden staircases emerging into secluded Chambers D and E. Complete the sliding tile picture puzzles in each chamber to unlock the subterranean inner sanctum where swarms of ancient Unown awaken. Search the chamber alcoves and smash cracked boulders to recover a Life Orb, Rare Bone, and Star Pieces.

items.name: Life Orb
items.method: Hidden behind an ancient ceremonial statue inside the chamber

items.name: Star Piece
items.method: Hidden beside a carved stone pillar in the chamber ruins

items.name: Rare Bone
items.method: Found behind smashable boulders in the southern excavation pit

items.name: Nugget
items.method: Located behind smashable rocks near the eastern exit gate

items.name: Escape Rope
items.method: Found in the southeastern chamber corridor behind a boulder
